messages:
maria: quick check — signet trial preflight. Legal is green but we still need clear owners for infra, eng, SE, and security for the cutover next Tue. Can folks reply with owners + any blockers by EOD?

raj: infra owner here — I'll take VPC peering + staging subnet. Need the subnet created by Mon EOD. @claire can you confirm firewall ports?

claire: got it. firewall needs to allow 10.2.0.0/16 -> signet IPs on 443 and 5432. I will open a ticket (SEC-1187) and aim to have rules applied Mon noon. Also we need certs for staging (tls.redwood-staging).

alex: SE owner — alex here. Integration checklist I care about: API keys, example payload, embeddings mapping. Pushed a short doc to the shared drive: https://redwood.app/notes/signet-integration (internal).

maria: thanks. on certs — can we reuse the staging wildcard cert or do we need a new SAN cert? @claire @security-bot

security-bot: automated check: signet-trial-security-scan not run on the draft checklist. Flagging manual review for data retention and PII handling. Recommend security review before go/no-go.

nick: eng owner here. I'll pick up SDK integration and runtime config. @sam can you estimate the code review window for the PR I opened?

sam: can do CR today — I left a few comments on batching and edge cases in PR #342. Example note:
```
# batching config suggestion
BATCH_SIZE=16
LATENCY_SLO=200ms
CACHE_TTL=30s
```
I'll re-check after updates.

alex: pulled from SE — success criteria proposed: 95th percentile latency < 300ms under 1k QPS synthetic load, embeddings cosine similarity baseline within 0.02 of staging model, and all required API fields returned in the response. Also request we pin a model variant for the trial.

maria: agreed on criteria. We'll pin to redwood/ggml-v2-8bit for initial run; fallback policy to v2-4bit if cost constraints trigger. @nick please ensure rollout policy enforces pin and fallback.

nick: noted. I'll add rollout config to the deployment and include a canary with 10% traffic first. Also need a test token from SE.

alex: shared test tokens in 1Password under Signet/Trial. Ping me if you need ephemeral keys.

maria: owners summary: infra: raj, eng: nick, se: alex, security: claire. Blocking items: staging subnet (raj), certs (claire), CR comments (sam). Any objections?

raj: no objections. I'll file INFRA-502 and tag infra-oncall. Subnet request submitted.

claire: filing cert ticket now (CERT-221). I'll coordinate with ops for SAN if wildcard isn't acceptable.

sam: CR updated with a small TTL change and a note about race conditions in cache invalidation. @nick please address my last comment.

nick: will update before EOD and mark PR ready for merge.

maria: perfect — thanks everyone. If nothing else, let's reconvene async tomorrow for verification. :rocket:
